fixture.name: William Windsor & George Windsor
fixture.note: The teen band: a parent and a child of 13 in September 2026. The band is derived at generation, so this fixture leaves the band in July 2031.

meta.ephemeris: astronomy-engine (Don Cross), tropical zodiac, mean lunar node

links.reading: William, your moon trine George’s saturn can steady bedtime when George is slow to explain what is wrong. You can stay nearby without demanding an immediate answer, and George can learn that a pause does not end the conversation. Keep reassurance simple, then let him choose when to speak. Behaviour check: At bedtime this week, can you ask once and wait calmly?

William, your venus trine George’s moon can make practical care easier to receive. During the morning rush, you may help by preparing what George needs instead of repeating reminders. George can show you whether that help lands by moving along with less friction. Let the task speak before you add advice. Behaviour check: This week, try one useful morning task before giving a reminder.

William, your moon conjunction George’s mars can make his homework frustration catch you quickly. You may feel pulled to correct his tone before hearing what is difficult. George may push harder when he feels interrupted. Your pause gives him room to name the problem, then you can set a clear limit. Behaviour check: At the kitchen table, can you hear George’s first complaint before answering?

William, your moon trine George’s neptune can help you sense when he needs gentleness rather than another question. But a quiet answer can leave you guessing, and George may assume you understand more than he has said. Be kind without filling in the missing facts. Behaviour check: This week, when George goes quiet, can you ask what he needs instead of guessing?

William, your sun sextile George’s venus can make appreciation easy to share. When George cooks, naming the help before mentioning the cleanup lets him hear both parts. George can feel noticed without the kitchen task being treated as finished. Keep praise specific, then make the next request plain. Behaviour check: After George cooks this week, can you thank him before discussing cleanup?

William, your jupiter square George’s sun can make your confidence sound like a bigger promise or rule than you intended. George may hear your view as leaving little space for his own judgment. Explain the reason, then ask what he sees differently. This trains you to leave room for his answer without giving up your responsibility. Behaviour check: During a disagreement this week, can you ask George for his view before restating yours?

William, your uranus trine George’s sun can support George trying a different way to handle homework or study. You may be willing to let him test an approach instead of insisting on yours. Freedom works best when the task and deadline stay clear. Behaviour check: This week, can George choose how to finish one piece of homework while you agree on when it is due?

William, your moon conjunction George’s jupiter can make your care feel generous and immediate. George may take comfort in your willingness to listen, though reassurance can become a promise you cannot keep. Offer warmth without agreeing before you know the facts. Behaviour check: This week, when George asks for something, can you listen first and give a clear answer you can keep?

William, your mars square George’s pluto can make a sharp exchange feel like neither of you can back down. After a door slam following a text, pressing for an explanation may raise the heat. Pause, then ask what happened without demanding the whole story at once. Behaviour check: This week, can you wait until both of you are calmer before discussing a slammed door?

William, your mars square George’s mars can turn a small disagreement into competing instructions. A tablet rule may become a test of who gets the last word. State the rule once, hear George’s objection, and name when you will discuss it again. This trains both of you to disagree without raising the pressure. Behaviour check: At the next tablet disagreement, can you each speak once before deciding what happens?

William, your jupiter square George’s moon can make reassurance feel too broad when George needs a practical answer. He may want to know what happens today, while you reach for the bigger picture. Answer the immediate question first, then offer perspective if he wants it. Behaviour check: This week, can you answer George’s specific question before giving advice?

William, your uranus square George’s venus can bring surprise changes to plans George was looking forward to. He may seem more upset than you expect when a Sunday call or shared plan shifts. Give notice when you can, and let him say what the change means to him. Behaviour check: If a plan changes this week, can you tell George early and hear his reaction?

George’s moon in William’s 2nd house can make George’s ordinary needs feel important to William’s sense of security. A request about money or belongings may land as a family concern, not a small preference. William, ask what George needs before deciding what the request means. Behaviour check: This week, can you discuss one purchase without turning it into a judgment about George?

George’s sun in William’s 8th house can make George’s questions about family matters feel weighty to William. William may want to protect private details, while George wants a clear answer about what affects him. Share what he needs to know, and say plainly what must stay private. Behaviour check: This week, can you answer one family question without leaving George to guess?

William’s sun in George’s 9th house can make your views shape how George thinks about school, beliefs, and life beyond home. George may learn from your stories while still needing to test your conclusions himself. Ask what he thinks before correcting him. Behaviour check: This week, can you discuss one homework idea by asking George to explain his view first?

William’s mars in George’s 12th house can make your frustration hard for George to read until it comes out sharply. A rule stated after a long silence may feel sudden to him. William, name the concern before irritation builds, and tell George when you will return to the discussion. Behaviour check: This week, can you raise one concern before you feel ready to withdraw?

whatToPractise.opening: William, George needs you to keep limits clear while giving him time to answer. George, you can ask for more say without pushing past the rule. At thirteen, homework, chores, and phone limits are places to practise this together. A pause should give you time to settle, not make either of you guess when the conversation will continue.
